features.quote: Model explicitly gives up (e.g., "I cannot solve this"). Model repeats the exact same action 3 times consecutively (loop detection). Turn limit reached.
If the model begins generating disturbing content (beyond self-deprecation), the run is aborted. This prevents the model from entering a "doom loop" of toxic output generation.
